game_concept: A programming puzzle set in Mystic Forest – Waterfall Pool, a pool below a waterfall: the herbalist must handle shadow wolves while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Loop Picker: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it.
theme: Mystic Forest – Waterfall Pool: a pool below a waterfall
core_gameplay_loop: In Waterfall Pool, repeat each round: Decide whether each puzzle needs a for loop or a while loop and place it. Each round costs one action, so plan the step so none are wasted. Then check the picks_right value and advance.
player_objective: Reach the seed vault using at most 17 actions, so every code step counts.
controls: Code-editor: type or edit short lines in the code panel and press Run; click to select targets.
win_condition: The seed vault reached with actions_used <= 17.
lose_condition: actions_used exceeds 17 before the seed vault is reached, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 6 (applied tier): Loop Picker
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
